items.title: Single-Hue Clarity
items.text: Every border, tint, bevel highlight, shadow, glow, and cursor derives mathematically from one CSS variable (--lit).

items.title: Controlled Nostalgia
items.text: Crisp 0px pixel chrome for atmosphere, paired with one-click Reading Mode for long-form Latin and CJK essays.

items.title: Static First
items.text: Zero required server runtime. Deploy dist/ to Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, Netlify, or GitHub Pages in seconds.

items.title: AI-Ready Spec

items.question: Does Astro Phosphor require a backend server or database?
items.answer: No. Every page, project showcase, MDX journal post, design specimen, and offline arcade game compiles to 100% static files in dist/.

items.question: Can I switch the phosphor color or tone down the CRT scanlines?
items.answer: Open Menu -> System (or visit /design-system) to cycle between Amber, Green, Blue, and White phosphor presets, or enable Reading Mode for calm long-form reading.

items.question: How do I replace the desk background with my own retro monitor photo?
items.answer: Follow the built-in crt-room-artwork Agent Skill in .agents/skills/crt-room-artwork/SKILL.md and run npm run art:room to generate responsive WebP plates.
